player.name: James Harden
player.physicalDescription: 6'5" left-handed shooting guard, known for his step-back jumper, beard, and playmaking ability.

figure.name: Delilah
figure.attributeDescription: A pair of ornate, but wickedly sharp scissors, used to cut Samson's hair, symbolizing betrayal.
figure.clothing: Flowing, richly colored Philistine garments, with intricate jewelry and adornments.
figure.physicalDescription: A Philistine woman, known for her beauty and cunning. Delilah is depicted as alluring and confident, but with a hint of deceit in her eyes. She is dressed in fine Philistine garments, befitting her station as a woman of influence.

connection.thematic: Masters of deception who win by making you believe something that isn't true
connection.narrative: Delilah found Samson's weakness. Harden finds yours, one step-back at a time.
connection.relationship: Illusionists who turn an opponent's own strength against them

scripture.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר דְּלִילָה אֶל־שִׁמְשׁוֹן הַגִּידָה־נָּא לִי בַּמֶּה כֹּחֲךָ גָדוֹל וּבַמֶּה תֵאָסֵר לְעַנּוֹתֶךָ׃
scripture.english: And Delilah said to Samson: ‘Tell me, I pray thee, wherein thy great strength lieth, and wherewith thou mightest be bound to afflict thee.’

connection.receipt: 2018 MVP; 3 straight scoring titles built on the step-back
